limitations.quote: End the match pulse and retain the final 0
limitations.note: The patch fixed the duplicate state encoding but also added overlapping-match behavior by changing the post-match transitions for a valid 1 and an invalid sample, both of which the reference leaves returning to idle.
The test checked every rolling window of valid bits, so it expected overlapping matches and could not flag the extra pulses that differed from the original FSM's intended behavior.
